scope: Offline structural counts only; no GPU launch, no timing or end-to-end claim

layouts.L1: nonempty leaf IDs ascending; each leaf's physical IDs ascending
layouts.L2: nonempty depth-3 subtree IDs ascending; each subtree's physical IDs ascending
layouts.L3: DFS ascending child ID; each leaf retains qualified tree order

ownership: Global shared pivots, explicitly confirmed by the user before measurement

strategies.S0: first eight distinct physical pivot row IDs in nonempty qualified tree nodes, ascending heap node ID, excluding negative root pivot
strategies.S1: farthest-first traversal seeded at physical row 0; maximize minimum ordered FP64 squared distance to chosen pivots, ties smallest physical row ID; exclude selected rows
strategies.S2: NumPy PCG64 seed 20261010, choose eight physical row IDs without replacement

query_cost: P distinct query-pivot pairs/query, no early exit; scalar reads = 2*P*total_blocks; counts are not speed
numerics: Ordered FP64 C++ subtraction/product/sum, no contraction or fast math; outward interval from squared score using epsilon=(4*D+16)*2^-52; outward division/sqrt/add via nextafter; inflate radius for ordered-reference membership. See NUMERICS.md
aggregate: Arithmetic mean across all original 32 queries, each snapshot separate. One identical configuration must pass both snapshots; per-query rows and distribution summaries retained
oracle_ratio_gate: Each query whose oracle requires >=1% of total blocks must satisfy surviving <=2*oracle; smaller and zero-result queries reported separately, not used in this ratio gate
no_go: If on either snapshot every tested layout/strategy at P=8 has mean surviving-256 fraction >0.80, stop this global certificate design and do not run D. A single deliberately weak configuration does not reject a stronger configuration
D_admission: At least one identical layout/strategy/P<=8 configuration reaches mean surviving-256 fraction <=0.70 on both snapshots with zero false prune, and oracle mean <=0.30 on both. Otherwise mark D not run
GO: Same P<=4 configuration on both snapshots: mean surviving<=0.50, false prune=0, all non-tiny oracle ratios<=2; D changed fraction<=0.05, moved existing<=0.05*N, global repartition=0
CONDITIONAL: No GO and no explicit NO-GO; no CUDA promotion. Query reach 0.50-0.70 with low oracle calls for a different partition/low-cost summary, not more pivots
updates_if_admitted: Retain actual first interval 10I10D and second interval 20I20D; separately report second net entering/removing base 10/10. No relabeling 20/20 as 10/10; freeze best-match and split rule before D
stops: false prune rejects the configuration and stops for correctness diagnosis
no new CUDA kernel this round
